parameters.query:
select a.id as agenda_id, a.conversacion_id, a.detalle,
  c.telefono, c.contacto_id, c.canal_numero,
  ca.botmaker_token, ca.handoff_intent_id, ca.cola
from agendamientos a
join conversaciones c on c.id = a.conversacion_id
join canales ca on ca.canal_numero = c.canal_numero and ca.activo
where a.estado = 'pendiente' and a.fecha_hora <= now()
  and c.contacto_id is not null and ca.botmaker_token is not null;
